name: Depth-Guided Sampling
definition: A sampling strategy that focuses scene sampling on estimated surface regions using depth priors from input views to increase sample density in relevant areas, improving synthesis quality and allowing reduction of samples per ray.
summary: Depth-Guided Sampling is a ray sampling strategy that uses depth priors to focus samples on surface regions, differing from uniform sampling by leveraging probability density fields and Gaussian boosting to improve quality and efficiency.
